name: supplier-pulse
description: Checks the supplier's current Companies House status (signed via API3 AirnodeHub) before the next milestone payment of a SupplierPulse order and applies the decision on chain: paid, waiting for approval, or held. Paid for the verified decision, refunded if none could be made.

data.description: Your order in the SupplierPulse contract. The agent checks the supplier before its next payment.
Companies House number of the supplier, e.g. 01234567
